translationRepairs: Reform the harem: fix precedence so favorites cannot monopolize favor or breed arrogance; check the chaos of Bao Si and Zhao Feiyan; let humble consorts rise in due order, each to her station, to widen the chance of heirs and still the jealousies sung in the "White Flowers"; enrich in-laws with gold but bar them from office like the royal fathers of old, and clip the power of consort clans—when the inner quarters are ordered, the realm does not fall into chaos.

Reform the harem: fix precedence so favorites cannot monopolize favor or breed arrogance; check the chaos of Bao Si and Lady Yan; let humble consorts rise in due order, each to her station, to widen the chance of heirs and still the jealousies sung in the "White Flowers"; enrich in-laws with gold but bar them from office like the royal fathers of old, and clip the power of consort clans—when the inner quarters are ordered, the realm does not fall into chaos.
褒、閻 names Bao and Yan; Zhao Feiyan (趙飛燕) is not in the Chinese and invents the wrong consort.

Labor day and night in the stern virtue of yiyin day: keep your charge, aid the throne, punish evil without sparing kin, promote good without shunning enemies—only thus can you show perfect fairness and win trust across the realm.

Labor day and night in the stern virtue of Yi Yin: keep your charge, aid the throne, punish evil without sparing kin, promote good without shunning enemies—only thus can you show perfect fairness and win trust across the realm.
伊尹 is the Shang minister Yi Yin; “yiyin day” is a corrupted misreading of that personal name.

You ought morning and night be diligent, grasp yiyin day's strong virtue, thereby to guard duty and correct the ruler, punish wickedness without shrinking from kin and loved ones, raise good without shrinking from foes and enemies, thereby to display utmost fairness, establish trust in the four directions.

You ought morning and night be diligent, grasp Yi Yin's strong virtue, thereby to guard duty and correct the ruler, punish wickedness without shrinking from kin and loved ones, raise good without shrinking from foes and enemies, thereby to display utmost fairness, establish trust in the four directions.
伊尹之強德 is Yi Yin’s strong virtue; the literal “yiyin day” is the same name corruption.
Gu Yong's learning was broad but shallow compared with Du Qin, Du Ye, or the depth of Liu Xiang and his son and Yang Xiong.
Gu Yong's learning in the classics was broad but superficial, roughly equal to that of Du Qin and Du Ye, though not as thorough as that of Liu Xiang and his son or Yang Xiong.
與杜欽、杜鄴略等 means roughly equal to Du Qin and Du Ye; the original wrongly ranks Yong beneath them.
His son Du Lin loved antiquity and had talent; under Guangwu he rose to Grand Minister of Works.
His son Du Lin was quiet, fond of antiquity, and endowed with refined talent. During Jianwu, he served successively among the ranked ministers and rose to Grand Minister of Works.
Chinese has 建武中 only, with 清靜好古 and 歷位列卿; “under Guangwu” invents an unstated personal name and drops those details.
Gu Yong's "three-seven" warning was true loyalty; yet he cited Shen Bo to flatter Wang Feng, sowed strife with Ping'e, and read Venus and Mars to suit his patrons—candor thin, words many.
Gu Yong's "three-seven" warning was true loyalty; yet he cited Shen Bo to flatter Wang Feng, sowed strife with Ping'a, and read Venus and Mars to suit his patrons—candor thin, words many.
平阿 is the title Ping’a; Ping’e is a wrong transliteration of the same two graphs.
